# Moderate_Correlation_Regime

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The parameter space where interaction strength is comparable to kinetic energy, leading to non-perturbative but not fully localized electronic behavior. Captures the intermediate coupling physics that may enable tunable nonlinear responses in in-network computing substrates.
